notes: The 'Kurgan' is the site's central part and the unit's other name in WBADB, so directions from it are taken as from the unit. f1: burial cave, words N 50 m (plan fig. 326, north arrow pointing upper right, agrees: ~356 deg, ~60 m). f2: 'hewn basin' with no size -> pool_def unclear. f3: tumulus close to the elongated structure that lies ~120 m NW of the Kurgan; coded NW from the unit with no distance (the 120 m is the structure's). f4: second tumulus shown only on the plan (near 'Installation'), roughly NNW ~180 m of the Kurgan, but position left 'none' (not in the text). Tumuli coded as graves because 'tumulus' means a burial mound; the entry does not explicitly call them tombs. The Kurgan itself (ash and burnt bones, interpreted as a cultic fire-sacrifice centre) was not coded as a grave.
